brand.name: Antonia's Pizza
brand.positioning: Hand-crafted dough, home-made tomato sauce, SLO style seasoned crust. Pies from 10" to 28". SLO exclusive.
differentiators: SLO exclusive — not a chain, no other locations outside the two
Signature Ajarski dough boat (Adjarian khachapuri style)
Pies up to 28 inches (XL group format)
Late-night kitchen — open until 2 AM on weekend nights
Mediterranean crossover: manakeesh, gyro pizza, feta, za'atar
Also operates Johnny's Lunch food truck

taglineCandidates: Open till 2 AM. Dough made in-house.

reviews.source: Displayed on the live homepage — real, attributed, 5-star

items.author: Patricia B.
items.quote: Hands down some of the best pizza in SLO! Great service, perfect flavors, and an unbelievable crust. It's so good that my nephew from Texas—who NEVER eats the crust—cleaned his entire plate. He was ready to look up his closest location back home until we found out Antonia's is a SLO exclusive. Highly recommend!

items.author: Cecily F.
items.quote: Ordered for delivery and HANDS DOWN one of the best pizzas I've had in SLO. Opening the box and immediately being encompassed in the scent of oregano and various herbs was like being wrapped in a warm blanket. Cooked perfectly, didn't skimp on toppings and the texture of the crust was amazing! 10/10

items.author: Kelly H.
items.quote: Pizza is the bomb! The crust, sauce, all the fresh toppings are exquisite. And there is so much other stuff on the menu to try. I love their pastas too especially the creamy pesto. Definitely going to go through and try their other stuff. Also, don't skip dessert! They now have tiramisu and cannolis and the tiramisu was literally the best I've ever had!!

items.author: Walid S.
items.quote: Had a crazy late shift and was craving some high-quality food, not just typical fast food. Googled 'late night pizza near me' and saw Antonia's was still open. Called them up and was honestly surprised how accommodating they were for a late delivery. We ordered a standard Pepperoni pizza (crust was on point), the Pesto Chicken pie (the flavor profile on this one is incredible), and half a pie with Vegan Cheese for my wife.
valueSignals: LATE NIGHT — found via 'late night pizza near me'

items.author: Devin C.
items.quote: Very excited to try this new pizza spot at the former location of Pizza Solo. I ordered the gyro pizza which was tasty and quickly made, which worked great for my lunch break. My friend and I also tried the manakeesh pizza, but left the feta cheese off, and it was quite tasty. I'll definitely be back to try their other Mediterranean dishes and salads.

reviews.insight: Two reviews independently confirm the late-night search intent ('late night pizza near me') and the Mediterranean crossover (gyro, manakeesh). Neither is surfaced anywhere on the current homepage. These are unclaimed positioning assets.
